translation_policy: Russian values are faithful translations of the cited passages, not claims to reproduce a particular published Russian translation. Short excerpts may omit surrounding sentences. Source passages retain source spelling; display punctuation and capitalization follow mod rules. Character dialogue is identified in the location or note.

superevent_itora_civilwar_quote.source_passage: A house divided against itself cannot stand
superevent_itora_civilwar_quote.russian:
Дом, разделившийся сам в себе, не устоит.

- Авраам Линкольн, 1858
superevent_itora_civilwar_quote.english:
A house divided against itself cannot stand.

- Abraham Lincoln, 1858
superevent_itora_civilwar_quote.note: Lincoln is quoting Mark 3:25; attribution identifies the documented speech, not original authorship of the biblical expression.

superevent_itora_committee_victory_quote.source_passage: And Covenants, without the Sword, are but Words, and of no strength to secure a man at all
superevent_itora_committee_victory_quote.russian:
А соглашения без меча - лишь слова, которые не в силах гарантировать человеку безопасность.
- Томас Гоббс, "Левиафан", XVII
superevent_itora_committee_victory_quote.english:
And covenants, without the sword, are but words and of no strength to secure a man at all.
- Thomas Hobbes, "Leviathan", XVII

superevent_itora_legion_victory_quote.russian:
Imperium sine fine dedi.
Я даровал им власть без конца.
- Вергилий, "Энеида", I, 279 (перевод с латинского)
superevent_itora_legion_victory_quote.english:
Imperium sine fine dedi.
I have granted them empire without end.
- Virgil, Aeneid, I, 279 (translated from Latin)
superevent_itora_legion_victory_quote.note: Latin macrons omitted in the display; Russian and English translations accompany the original.

superevent_itora_stalk_portal_quote.source_passage: I have seen beyond the bounds of infinity and drawn down daemons from the stars
superevent_itora_stalk_portal_quote.russian:
Я заглянул за пределы бесконечности и вызвал демонов со звёзд.
- Г. Ф. Лавкрафт, "Извне" (перевод с английского)
superevent_itora_stalk_portal_quote.english:
I have seen beyond the bounds of infinity and drawn down daemons from the stars.
- H. P. Lovecraft, "From Beyond"

superevent_itora_vorkerland_war_anton_qu.source_passage: But war, in a good cause, is not the greatest evil which a nation can suffer
superevent_itora_vorkerland_war_anton_qu.russian:
Война за правое дело - не величайшее зло, какое может постигнуть народ.

- Джон Стюарт Милль, 1862
superevent_itora_vorkerland_war_anton_qu.english:
But war, in a good cause, is not the greatest evil which a nation can suffer.

- John Stuart Mill, 1862

superevent_itora_vorkerland_war_dorian_q.source_passage: War therefore is an act of violence intended to compel our opponent to fulfil our will
superevent_itora_vorkerland_war_dorian_q.russian:
Итак, война - это акт насилия, имеющий целью заставить противника выполнить нашу волю.

- Карл фон Клаузевиц, "О войне"
superevent_itora_vorkerland_war_dorian_q.english:
War therefore is an act of violence intended to compel our opponent to fulfil our will.

- Carl von Clausewitz, On War

superevent_itora_vorkerland_war_quote.source_passage: for we toil that we may rest, and war that we may be at peace
superevent_itora_vorkerland_war_quote.russian:
Мы ведём войну, чтобы жить в мире.

- Аристотель, "Никомахова этика"
superevent_itora_vorkerland_war_quote.english:
We make war that we may live in peace.

- Aristotle, Nicomachean Ethics

superevent_itora_vorkerland_war_vlad_quo.source_passage: war is not to be avoided, but is only to be put off to the advantage of others
superevent_itora_vorkerland_war_vlad_quo.russian:
Войны нельзя избежать, можно лишь оттянуть её - к выгоде противника.

- Никколо Макиавелли, "Государь"
superevent_itora_vorkerland_war_vlad_quo.english:
War is not to be avoided, but is only to be put off to the advantage of others.

- Niccolo Machiavelli, The Prince

superevent_nam_resource_war_district_quo.source_passage: He will win whose army is animated by the same spirit throughout all its ranks
superevent_nam_resource_war_district_quo.russian:
Победит тот, чья армия во всех своих рядах проникнута единым духом.

- Сунь-цзы, "Искусство войны", III
superevent_nam_resource_war_district_quo.english:
He will win whose army is animated by the same spirit throughout all its ranks.

- Sun Tzu, "The Art of War", III

superevent_nam_resource_war_quote.location: Chapter IV, How to Smash This Racket
superevent_nam_resource_war_quote.source_passage: A few profit - and the many pay.
superevent_nam_resource_war_quote.russian:
Немногие наживаются - многие платят.

- Смедли Батлер, "Война - это рэкет"
superevent_nam_resource_war_quote.english:
A few profit - and the many pay.

- Smedley Butler, War Is a Racket

superevent_nam_resource_war_service_quot.source_passage: The art of war is of vital importance to the State
superevent_nam_resource_war_service_quot.russian:
Искусство войны жизненно важно для государства.

- Сунь-цзы, "Искусство войны", I
superevent_nam_resource_war_service_quot.english:
The art of war is of vital importance to the State.

- Sun Tzu, "The Art of War", I

superevent_nam_veyran_proclamation_quote.russian:
Репутация могущества есть могущество.

- Томас Гоббс, "Левиафан", X
superevent_nam_veyran_proclamation_quote.english:
Reputation of power is power.

- Thomas Hobbes, "Leviathan", X

superevent_rus_black_banner_quote.source_passage: Regard your soldiers as your children, and they will follow you into the deepest valleys
superevent_rus_black_banner_quote.russian:
Смотри на солдат как на своих детей, и они пойдут за тобой в самые глубокие долины.

- Сунь-цзы, "Искусство войны", X
superevent_rus_black_banner_quote.english:
Regard your soldiers as your children, and they will follow you into the deepest valleys.

- Sun Tzu, "The Art of War", X

superevent_rus_khan_defeated_quote.source_passage: Look on my works, ye Mighty, and despair! Nothing beside remains.
superevent_rus_khan_defeated_quote.russian:
Взгляните на мои творения, сильные мира, и отчаивайтесь! Больше ничего не осталось.

- Перси Биши Шелли, "Озимандия"
superevent_rus_khan_defeated_quote.english:
Look on my works, ye Mighty, and despair! Nothing beside remains.

- Percy Bysshe Shelley, Ozymandias

superevent_rus_last_empire_quote.source_passage: And Covenants, without the Sword, are but Words
superevent_rus_last_empire_quote.russian:
Соглашения без меча - лишь слова.

- Томас Гоббс, "Левиафан"
superevent_rus_last_empire_quote.english:
Covenants, without the sword, are but words.

- Thomas Hobbes, Leviathan

superevent_rus_restoration_quote.source_passage: Knowledge and human power are synonymous
superevent_rus_restoration_quote.russian:
Знание и могущество человека совпадают.

- Фрэнсис Бэкон, "Новый Органон", I, 3
superevent_rus_restoration_quote.english:
Knowledge and human power are synonymous.

- Francis Bacon, "Novum Organum", I.3

superevent_south_boards_quote.location: Manifesto of the Communist Party, I
superevent_south_boards_quote.source_passage: The executive of the modern State is but a committee for managing the common affairs of the whole bourgeoisie
superevent_south_boards_quote.russian:
Современная государственная власть - это лишь комитет, управляющий общими делами всего класса буржуазии.

- Карл Маркс и Фридрих Энгельс, "Манифест Коммунистической партии"
superevent_south_boards_quote.english:
The executive of the modern State is but a committee for managing the common affairs of the whole bourgeoisie.

- Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels, "Manifesto of the Communist Party"

superevent_south_charter_quote.location: Second Treatise of Government, VIII, section 95
superevent_south_charter_quote.source_passage: no one can be put out of this estate, and subjected to the political power of another, without his own consent
superevent_south_charter_quote.russian:
Никто не может быть выведен из этого состояния и подчинён политической власти другого без собственного согласия.

- Джон Локк, "Второй трактат о правлении", 95
superevent_south_charter_quote.english:
No one can be put out of this estate, and subjected to the political power of another, without his own consent.

- John Locke, "Second Treatise of Government", 95
superevent_south_charter_quote.note: This estate refers to the preceding description of people as naturally free, equal and independent.

superevent_south_cities_quote.source_passage: The people, being subject to the laws, ought to be their author
superevent_south_cities_quote.russian:
Народ, подчиняющийся законам, должен быть их автором.

- Жан-Жак Руссо, "Об общественном договоре", II, 6
superevent_south_cities_quote.english:
The people, being subject to the laws, ought to be their author.

- Jean-Jacques Rousseau, "The Social Contract", II.6

superevent_south_civil_service_quote.source_passage: Equal and exact justice to all men, of whatever state or persuasion, religious or political
superevent_south_civil_service_quote.russian:
Равная и беспристрастная справедливость для всех людей, независимо от их положения, религиозных или политических убеждений.

- Томас Джефферсон, первая инаугурационная речь
superevent_south_civil_service_quote.english:
Equal and exact justice to all men, of whatever state or persuasion, religious or political.

- Thomas Jefferson, First Inaugural Address

superevent_south_commune_quote.location: Manifesto of the Communist Party, II
superevent_south_commune_quote.source_passage: the free development of each is the condition for the free development of all
superevent_south_commune_quote.russian:
Свободное развитие каждого является условием свободного развития всех.

- Карл Маркс и Фридрих Энгельс, "Манифест Коммунистической партии"
superevent_south_commune_quote.english:
The free development of each is the condition for the free development of all.

- Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels, "Manifesto of the Communist Party"

superevent_south_conclave_quote.location: The Wealth of Nations, I.X, part II
superevent_south_conclave_quote.source_passage: the conversation ends in a conspiracy against the public, or in some contrivance to raise prices
superevent_south_conclave_quote.russian:
Разговор заканчивается сговором против общества или какой-нибудь уловкой для повышения цен.

- Адам Смит, "Богатство народов", I, X
superevent_south_conclave_quote.english:
The conversation ends in a conspiracy against the public, or in some contrivance to raise prices.

- Adam Smith, "The Wealth of Nations", I.X
superevent_south_conclave_quote.note: Excerpt from the sentence about people of the same trade meeting together, even for merriment and diversion.

superevent_south_contract_republic_quote.location: Second Treatise of Government, XIX, section 202
superevent_south_contract_republic_quote.russian:
Где кончается закон, начинается тирания.

- Джон Локк, "Второй трактат о правлении", 202
superevent_south_contract_republic_quote.english:
Wherever law ends, tyranny begins.

- John Locke, "Second Treatise of Government", 202

superevent_south_contracts_quote.location: Leviathan, XV, third law of nature
superevent_south_contracts_quote.source_passage: That Men Performe Their Covenants Made
superevent_south_contracts_quote.russian:
Люди должны выполнять заключённые ими соглашения.

- Томас Гоббс, "Левиафан", XV
superevent_south_contracts_quote.english:
That men perform their covenants made.

- Thomas Hobbes, "Leviathan", XV

superevent_south_directorate_quote.source_passage: Consumption is the sole end and purpose of all production
superevent_south_directorate_quote.russian:
Потребление - единственная цель и назначение всякого производства.

- Адам Смит, "Богатство народов", IV, VIII
superevent_south_directorate_quote.english:
Consumption is the sole end and purpose of all production.

- Adam Smith, "The Wealth of Nations", IV.VIII

superevent_south_federation_quote.source_passage: the power indeed may be transmitted, but not the will
superevent_south_federation_quote.russian:
Власть можно передать, но волю - нельзя.

- Жан-Жак Руссо, "Об общественном договоре", II, 1
superevent_south_federation_quote.english:
The power indeed may be transmitted, but not the will.

- Jean-Jacques Rousseau, "The Social Contract", II.1

superevent_south_free_islands_quote.location: Odyssey, IX, Odysseus speaking, Samuel Butler translation
superevent_south_free_islands_quote.source_passage: there is nothing dearer to a man than his own country and his parents
superevent_south_free_islands_quote.russian:
Нет для человека ничего дороже родной земли и родителей.

- Гомер, "Одиссея", IX
superevent_south_free_islands_quote.english:
There is nothing dearer to a man than his own country and his parents.

- Homer, "Odyssey", IX

superevent_south_houses_quote.source_passage: All for ourselves, and nothing for other people, seems, in every age of the world, to have been the vile maxim of the masters of mankind
superevent_south_houses_quote.russian:
Всё для себя и ничего для других - таков, по-видимому, во все времена был гнусный девиз властителей человечества.

- Адам Смит, "Богатство народов", III, IV
superevent_south_houses_quote.english:
All for ourselves, and nothing for other people, seems, in every age of the world, to have been the vile maxim of the masters of mankind.

- Adam Smith, "The Wealth of Nations", III.IV

superevent_south_iron_quote.source_passage: men more quickly forget the death of their father than the loss of their patrimony
superevent_south_iron_quote.russian:
Люди скорее забывают смерть отца, чем потерю наследства.

- Никколо Макиавелли, "Государь", XVII
superevent_south_iron_quote.english:
Men more quickly forget the death of their father than the loss of their patrimony.

- Niccolo Machiavelli, "The Prince", XVII

superevent_south_nam_quote.source_passage: There is no instance of a country having benefited from prolonged warfare
superevent_south_nam_quote.russian:
Не бывало, чтобы затяжная война приносила стране пользу.

- Сунь-цзы, "Искусство войны", II
superevent_south_nam_quote.english:
There is no instance of a country having benefited from prolonged warfare.

- Sun Tzu, "The Art of War", II

superevent_south_nur_quote.source_passage: The chief foundations of all states, new as well as old or composite, are good laws and good arms
superevent_south_nur_quote.russian:
Главные основы всех государств, новых, старых или смешанных, - хорошие законы и хорошее войско.

- Никколо Макиавелли, "Государь", XII
superevent_south_nur_quote.english:
The chief foundations of all states, new as well as old or composite, are good laws and good arms.

- Niccolo Machiavelli, "The Prince", XII

superevent_south_oil_union_quote.location: Manifesto of the Communist Party, IV
superevent_south_oil_union_quote.source_passage: The proletarians have nothing to lose but their chains. They have a world to win
superevent_south_oil_union_quote.russian:
Пролетариям нечего терять, кроме своих цепей. Приобретут же они весь мир.

- Карл Маркс и Фридрих Энгельс, "Манифест Коммунистической партии"
superevent_south_oil_union_quote.english:
The proletarians have nothing to lose but their chains. They have a world to win.

- Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels, "Manifesto of the Communist Party"

superevent_south_radical_quote.source_passage: When you plunder a countryside, let the spoil be divided amongst your men
superevent_south_radical_quote.russian:
Грабя чужую землю, разделяй добычу между своими людьми.

- Сунь-цзы, "Искусство войны", VII
superevent_south_radical_quote.english:
When you plunder a countryside, let the spoil be divided amongst your men.

- Sun Tzu, "The Art of War", VII

superevent_south_regency_quote.source_passage: benefits ought to be given little by little, so that the flavour of them may last longer
superevent_south_regency_quote.russian:
Благодеяния следует оказывать понемногу, чтобы их вкус ощущался дольше.

- Никколо Макиавелли, "Государь", VIII
superevent_south_regency_quote.english:
Benefits ought to be given little by little, so that the flavour of them may last longer.

- Niccolo Machiavelli, "The Prince", VIII

superevent_south_restitution_quote.location: Second Treatise of Government, VI, section 57
superevent_south_restitution_quote.source_passage: the end of law is not to abolish or restrain, but to preserve and enlarge freedom
superevent_south_restitution_quote.russian:
Цель закона - не упразднять или ограничивать свободу, а сохранять и расширять её.

- Джон Локк, "Второй трактат о правлении", 57
superevent_south_restitution_quote.english:
The end of law is not to abolish or restrain, but to preserve and enlarge freedom.

- John Locke, "Second Treatise of Government", 57

superevent_south_revenge_quote.source_passage: In war, then, let your great object be victory, not lengthy campaigns
superevent_south_revenge_quote.russian:
Пусть главной целью войны будет победа, а не затяжные походы.

- Сунь-цзы, "Искусство войны", II
superevent_south_revenge_quote.english:
In war, then, let your great object be victory, not lengthy campaigns.

- Sun Tzu, "The Art of War", II

superevent_south_rump_quote.source_passage: We have it in our power to begin the world over again
superevent_south_rump_quote.russian:
В наших силах начать мир заново.

- Томас Пейн, "Здравый смысл"
superevent_south_rump_quote.english:
We have it in our power to begin the world over again.

- Thomas Paine, "Common Sense"

superevent_south_service_quote.source_passage: The end of Obedience is Protection
superevent_south_service_quote.russian:
Цель повиновения - защита.

- Томас Гоббс, "Левиафан", XXI
superevent_south_service_quote.english:
The end of obedience is protection.

- Thomas Hobbes, "Leviathan", XXI

superevent_south_war_quote.source_passage: WAR IS A MERE CONTINUATION OF POLICY BY OTHER MEANS
superevent_south_war_quote.russian:
Война есть лишь продолжение политики другими средствами.

- Карл фон Клаузевиц, "О войне", I, 1
superevent_south_war_quote.english:
War is a mere continuation of policy by other means.

- Carl von Clausewitz, "On War", I.1

superevent_stelander_empire_quote.location: The Wisdom of Life, chapter IV, section 1, Reputation
superevent_stelander_empire_quote.source_passage: The cheapest sort of pride is national pride
superevent_stelander_empire_quote.russian:
Самый дешёвый вид гордости - национальная гордость.

- Артур Шопенгауэр, "Афоризмы житейской мудрости"
superevent_stelander_empire_quote.english:
The cheapest sort of pride is national pride.

- Arthur Schopenhauer, "The Wisdom of Life"

superevent_stelander_party_victory_house.location: The Leopard, Part I, Tancredi speaking
superevent_stelander_party_victory_house.source_passage: If we want things to stay as they are, things will have to change
superevent_stelander_party_victory_house.russian:
Если мы хотим, чтобы всё осталось как есть, нужно, чтобы всё изменилось.

- Джузеппе Томази ди Лампедуза, "Леопард"
superevent_stelander_party_victory_house.english:
If we want things to stay as they are, things will have to change.

- Giuseppe Tomasi di Lampedusa, The Leopard
superevent_stelander_party_victory_house.note: Verified against the Italian Ministry of Culture's quotation of Tancredi's words. Russian is a translation, not a separately verified published Russian edition.

superevent_stelander_party_victory_quote.location: Nineteen Eighty-Four, Part III, chapter 3, O'Brien speaking
superevent_stelander_party_victory_quote.source_passage: The object of power is power
superevent_stelander_party_victory_quote.english:
The object of power is power.

- George Orwell, Nineteen Eighty-Four

superevent_stelander_party_victory_regen.location: History of the Peloponnesian War, V.89, Athenian envoys in the Melian Dialogue
superevent_stelander_party_victory_regen.source_passage: the strong do what they can and the weak suffer what they must
superevent_stelander_party_victory_regen.russian:
Сильные делают то, что могут, а слабые терпят то, что должны.

- Фукидид, "История"
superevent_stelander_party_victory_regen.english:
The strong do what they can and the weak suffer what they must.

- Thucydides, History of the Peloponnesian War

superevent_stelander_party_victory_silen.source_passage: where they make a desert, they call it peace
superevent_stelander_party_victory_silen.russian:
Где они создают пустыню, они называют это миром.

- Тацит, "Агрикола", 30
superevent_stelander_party_victory_silen.english:
Where they make a desert, they call it peace.

- Tacitus, "Agricola", 30

superevent_stelander_party_victory_staff.source_passage: Therefore, he who desires peace, let him prepare for war
superevent_stelander_party_victory_staff.russian:
Кто желает мира, пусть готовится к войне.

- Флавий Вегеций Ренат, "Краткое изложение военного дела"
superevent_stelander_party_victory_staff.english:
Let him who desires peace prepare for war.

- Vegetius, Epitoma rei militaris

superevent_stelander_party_victory_walle.source_passage: the sinews of war, infinite treasure
superevent_stelander_party_victory_walle.russian:
Нервы войны - неисчислимые деньги.

- Марк Туллий Цицерон, "Филиппики", V, 5
superevent_stelander_party_victory_walle.english:
The sinews of war, infinite treasure.

- Marcus Tullius Cicero, "Philippics", V.5
superevent_stelander_party_victory_walle.note: Excerpt from Cicero's description of the resources Antony would gain in Gaul; not a standalone maxim in the original sentence.

superevent_stelander_shabrat_republic_qu.source_passage: obedience to a law which we prescribe to ourselves is liberty
superevent_stelander_shabrat_republic_qu.russian:
Подчинение закону, который мы сами себе предписываем, есть свобода.

- Жан-Жак Руссо
superevent_stelander_shabrat_republic_qu.english:
Obedience to a law which we prescribe to ourselves is liberty.

- Jean-Jacques Rousseau

superevent_stelander_shabrat_victory_quo.location: The Tempest, Act II, scene 1, Antonio speaking
superevent_stelander_shabrat_victory_quo.russian:
Всё прошлое - лишь пролог.

- Уильям Шекспир, "Буря"
superevent_stelander_shabrat_victory_quo.english:
What's past is prologue.

- William Shakespeare, The Tempest

superevent_stelander_sotnikov_charter_qu.source_passage: the supremacy of the civil over the military authority
superevent_stelander_sotnikov_charter_qu.russian:
Верховенство гражданской власти над военной.

- Томас Джефферсон
superevent_stelander_sotnikov_charter_qu.english:
The supremacy of the civil over the military authority.

- Thomas Jefferson

superevent_stelander_sotnikov_civilwar_q.location: Second Inaugural Address, 4 March 1865, final paragraph
superevent_stelander_sotnikov_civilwar_q.source_passage: let us strive on to finish the work we are in to bind up the nation's wounds
superevent_stelander_sotnikov_civilwar_q.russian:
Давайте стремиться завершить начатое нами дело, залечить раны нации.

- Авраам Линкольн
superevent_stelander_sotnikov_civilwar_q.english:
Let us strive on to finish the work we are in to bind up the nation's wounds.

- Abraham Lincoln

superevent_stelander_sotnikov_directory_.source_passage: And Covenants, without the Sword, are but Words, and of no strength to secure a man at all
superevent_stelander_sotnikov_directory_.russian:
Договоры без меча - лишь слова, не способные обеспечить человеку безопасность.

- Томас Гоббс
superevent_stelander_sotnikov_directory_.english:
And covenants, without the sword, are but words, and of no strength to secure a man at all.

- Thomas Hobbes

superevent_stelander_tikhoreva_quote.source_passage: The multiplication of happiness is, according to the utilitarian ethics, the object of virtue
superevent_stelander_tikhoreva_quote.russian:
Приумножение счастья, согласно утилитарной этике, составляет цель добродетели.

- Джон Стюарт Милль
superevent_stelander_tikhoreva_quote.english:
The multiplication of happiness is, according to the utilitarian ethics, the object of virtue.

- John Stuart Mill

superevent_val_commonwealth_quote.location: De re publica, I.39, Scipio speaking
superevent_val_commonwealth_quote.russian:
Республика есть дело народа.

- Цицерон, "О государстве"
superevent_val_commonwealth_quote.english:
The commonwealth is the people's affair.

- Cicero, On the Republic

superevent_val_council_proclamation_quot.source_passage: Ollis salus populi suprema lex esto
superevent_val_council_proclamation_quot.russian:
Благо народа да будет высшим законом.

- Цицерон, "О законах", III, 8
superevent_val_council_proclamation_quot.english:
Let the welfare of the people be the supreme law.

- Cicero, On the Laws, III, 8

superevent_vorkerland_civilwar_quote.source_passage: war takes away the easy supply of daily wants, and so proves a rough master
superevent_vorkerland_civilwar_quote.russian:
Война лишает людей лёгкого удовлетворения повседневных нужд и потому оказывается суровым учителем.

- Фукидид, "История", III, 82
superevent_vorkerland_civilwar_quote.english:
War takes away the easy supply of daily wants, and so proves a rough master.

- Thucydides, "History of the Peloponnesian War", III.82

superevent_vorkerland_dirty_opening_quot.location: The Burial of the Dead, line 30
superevent_vorkerland_dirty_opening_quot.source_passage: I will show you fear in a handful of dust
superevent_vorkerland_dirty_opening_quot.russian:
Я покажу тебе страх в горсти праха.

- Т. С. Элиот, "Бесплодная земля"
superevent_vorkerland_dirty_opening_quot.english:
I will show you fear in a handful of dust.

- T. S. Eliot, The Waste Land

superevent_vorkerland_dorian_victory_quo.source_passage: the government of persons is replaced by the administration of things, and by the conduct of processes of production
superevent_vorkerland_dorian_victory_quo.russian:
Управление людьми заменяется управлением вещами и руководством процессами производства.

- Фридрих Энгельс, "Анти-Дюринг"
superevent_vorkerland_dorian_victory_quo.english:
The government of persons is replaced by the administration of things, and by the conduct of processes of production.

- Friedrich Engels, Anti-Duhring

superevent_vorkerland_utilitarian_victor.source_passage: it is the greatest happiness of the greatest number that is the measure of right and wrong
superevent_vorkerland_utilitarian_victor.russian:
Величайшее счастье величайшего числа - мера правильного и неправильного.

- Иеремия Бентам
superevent_vorkerland_utilitarian_victor.english:
It is the greatest happiness of the greatest number that is the measure of right and wrong.

- Jeremy Bentham, A Fragment on Government

superevent_vorkerland_vlad_victory_quote.source_passage: where they make a desert, they call it peace
superevent_vorkerland_vlad_victory_quote.russian:
Где они создают пустыню, они называют это миром.

- Тацит, "Агрикола", 30
superevent_vorkerland_vlad_victory_quote.english:
Where they make a desert, they call it peace.

- Tacitus, "Agricola", 30

superevent_vorkerland_worker_victory_quo.source_passage: for by concord even small states are increased, but by discord, even the greatest fall to nothing
superevent_vorkerland_worker_victory_quo.russian:
Согласием малые государства возвышаются, раздором величайшие рушатся.

- Саллюстий, "Югуртинская война"
superevent_vorkerland_worker_victory_quo.english:
By concord even small states are increased, but by discord, even the greatest fall to nothing.

- Sallust, The Jugurthine War

superevent_vorkerland_world_empire_quote.location: Ozymandias, line 10, inscription on the pedestal
superevent_vorkerland_world_empire_quote.source_passage: My name is Ozymandias, king of kings
superevent_vorkerland_world_empire_quote.russian:
Имя моё - Озимандия, царь царей.

- Перси Биши Шелли, "Озимандия"
superevent_vorkerland_world_empire_quote.english:
My name is Ozymandias, king of kings.

- Percy Bysshe Shelley, "Ozymandias"

superevent_west_anton_quote.source_passage: that standard is not the agent's own greatest happiness, but the greatest amount of happiness altogether
superevent_west_anton_quote.russian:
Мерило здесь - не наибольшее счастье самого действующего лица, а наибольшее общее количество счастья.

- Джон Стюарт Милль, "Утилитаризм", II
superevent_west_anton_quote.english:
That standard is not the agent's own greatest happiness, but the greatest amount of happiness altogether.

- John Stuart Mill, "Utilitarianism", II

superevent_west_committee_quote.source_passage: The Obligation of Subjects to the Soveraign is understood to last as long, and no longer, than the power lasteth, by which he is able to protect them
superevent_west_committee_quote.russian:
Обязанность подданных перед сувереном длится лишь до тех пор, пока существует власть, способная их защищать.

- Томас Гоббс, "Левиафан", XXI
superevent_west_committee_quote.english:
The obligation of subjects to the sovereign is understood to last as long, and no longer, than the power lasts, by which he is able to protect them.

- Thomas Hobbes, "Leviathan", XXI

superevent_west_council_quote.source_passage: If men were angels, no government would be necessary
superevent_west_council_quote.russian:
Если бы люди были ангелами, никакое правительство не было бы нужно.

- Джеймс Мэдисон, "Федералист", 51
superevent_west_council_quote.english:
If men were angels, no government would be necessary.

- James Madison, "The Federalist", 51

superevent_west_dorian_quote.source_passage: nature is only subdued by submission
superevent_west_dorian_quote.russian:
Природу побеждают, лишь подчиняясь ей.

- Фрэнсис Бэкон, "Новый Органон", I, 3
superevent_west_dorian_quote.english:
Nature is only subdued by submission.

- Francis Bacon, "Novum Organum", I.3

superevent_west_emergency_quote.source_passage: Where there is no common Power, there is no Law: where no Law, no Injustice
superevent_west_emergency_quote.russian:
Где нет общей власти, нет закона; где нет закона, нет несправедливости.

- Томас Гоббс, "Левиафан", XIII
superevent_west_emergency_quote.english:
Where there is no common power, there is no law: where no law, no injustice.

- Thomas Hobbes, "Leviathan", XIII

superevent_west_petrichev_quote.source_passage: it is much safer to be feared than loved, when, of the two, either must be dispensed with
superevent_west_petrichev_quote.russian:
Гораздо надёжнее внушать страх, чем любовь, если приходится отказаться от одного из двух.

- Никколо Макиавелли, "Государь", XVII
superevent_west_petrichev_quote.english:
It is much safer to be feared than loved, when, of the two, either must be dispensed with.

- Niccolo Machiavelli, "The Prince", XVII

superevent_west_revanche_quote.source_passage: injuries ought to be done all at one time, so that, being tasted less, they offend less
superevent_west_revanche_quote.russian:
Обиды следует наносить все разом, чтобы, ощущаемые меньше, они меньше задевали.

- Никколо Макиавелли, "Государь", VIII
superevent_west_revanche_quote.english:
Injuries ought to be done all at one time, so that, being tasted less, they offend less.

- Niccolo Machiavelli, "The Prince", VIII

superevent_west_shield_quote.location: Second Treatise of Government, IX, section 131
superevent_west_shield_quote.source_passage: And all this to be directed to no other end, but the peace, safety, and public good of the people
superevent_west_shield_quote.russian:
И всё это должно служить лишь миру, безопасности и общественному благу народа.

- Джон Локк, "Второй трактат о правлении", 131
superevent_west_shield_quote.english:
And all this to be directed to no other end, but the peace, safety, and public good of the people.

- John Locke, "Second Treatise of Government", 131

superevent_west_veyran_quote.location: The Tempest, Act II, scene 1, Antonio speaking
superevent_west_veyran_quote.russian:
Всё прошлое - лишь пролог.

- Уильям Шекспир, "Буря", II, 1
superevent_west_veyran_quote.english:
What's past is prologue.

- William Shakespeare, "The Tempest", II.1

superevent_west_worker_quote.source_passage: for by concord even small states are increased, but by discord, even the greatest fall to nothing
superevent_west_worker_quote.russian:
Согласием малые государства возвышаются, раздором величайшие рушатся.

- Саллюстий, "Югуртинская война", 10
superevent_west_worker_quote.english:
By concord even small states are increased, but by discord, even the greatest fall to nothing.

- Sallust, "Jugurthine War", 10

superevent_west_world_empire_quote.location: Aeneid, VI.851-853, Anchises speaking; John Dryden translation
superevent_west_world_empire_quote.source_passage: To tame the proud, the fetter’d slave to free: These are imperial arts, and worthy thee
superevent_west_world_empire_quote.russian:
Гордых смирять, освобождать раба от цепей - вот достойное тебя искусство империи.

- Вергилий, "Энеида", VI (по переводу Джона Драйдена)
superevent_west_world_empire_quote.english:
To tame the proud, the fetter'd slave to free: These are imperial arts, and worthy thee.

- Virgil, "Aeneid", VI (John Dryden translation)
superevent_west_world_empire_quote.note: Russian translates Dryden's English rendering, not the Latin line directly.
